'''Ed Bosco''' is an American actor for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}} and {{aniseries|HZ}}.

==Biography==
Bosco was born on January 24, 1986, in Chicago, Illinois, and became a voice actor as an adult. Bosco first worked on Pokémon by voicing characters in {{g|Masters EX}} and [[Pokémon: Twilight Wings]] before joining the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|JN}}. During ''Journeys'', Bosco was credited as Edward Bosco before becoming credited as Ed Bosco in {{aniseries|HZ}}.
